scope: read-only filesystem inventory, first logical tar member across all archives, complete logical member metadata in four sampled archives, current/historical source and two unrelated earlier training logs; no model calls, tensor calculations, corpus/tokenizer reads, training, or extraction
integrity_scope: All checkpoint top-level stat records and archive first 65536 compressed bytes checked before/after. Prefix SHA256 is NOT a full archive, decompressed header, or weight-content hash. Directory weights validated by names/sizes only. Complete four-archive member metadata scans validate layout, not tensor values. Prior early archive full SHA mentioned in historical reports is deliberately not reasserted here.

source_and_sampling_caveats: Archive outer mtimes usually record later compression, not checkpoint creation; embedded directory timestamps are used for archived checkpoint chronology. Filesystem/header mtimes remain mutable metadata, not authenticated training logs.
Current and b1f6e87 dataset code use mt19937_64 and uniform_int_distribution<size_t> to independently sample contiguous valid windows. Reset reseeds the generator.

Resume introduced by 28b2589 loads weights, then creates fresh Adam moments and a fresh sampler. Train resets that sampler before updates. Conditional same seed/corpus/window length/batch settings after a restart imply replay of initial random windows; historical settings and actual restarts remain unverified.
b1f6e87 source defaults: seed17, batch1 context-length sequence, context1024, learning_rate3e-4, beta1.9, beta2.95, epsilon1e-8, weight_decay.1. Source defaults do not prove invoked flags.
Gap580->590 spans resume-support source commit28b2589; gap1780->1790 spans unlimited-training source commit10a2e21. This is circumstantial, not proof of restarts or source provenance.
Neither available older train.log file establishes the sampling sequence, hyperparameters, optimizer continuity, or corpus split that produced these checkpoints.
Do not treat ten-step AdamW endpoint differences as raw gradients. Candidate token-row signatures are not sequence recovery.
